name: Durham College
description: Durham College of Applied Arts and Technology is located in the Durham Region of Ontario, Canada. The college offers a wide range of programs in a number of different disciplines including business, information technology, media, art, design, general arts, science, skilled trades, justice, emergency services, health and engineering technology.
